description: Source code for the NinjaBuildWriter class, which generates Ninja build files from GN build system data, including rules, pools, subninja references, and phony targets.

classes.name: NinjaBuildWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Ninja build files, rules, pools, subninjas, and phony targets based on GN build system data.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the process of writing Ninja rules, pools, subninjas, and phony/all rules.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFile
methods.description: Static method that generates the Ninja build file and writes it atomically to disk.

methods.name: ExtractRegenerationCommands
methods.description: Extracts the regeneration command block from an existing build.ninja file stream.

methods.name: WriteNinjaRules
methods.description: Writes the Ninja build rules, including the gn rule and dependencies.

methods.name: WriteAllPools
methods.description: Writes the pool definitions used in the build.

methods.name: WriteSubninjas
methods.description: Writes subninja references for each toolchain.

methods.name: WritePhonyAndAllRules
methods.description: Generates phony rules for targets, including the 'all' and 'default' targets.

methods.name: WritePhonyRule
methods.description: Helper to write individual phony rules for targets.
